$comment: Message keys for every form-rules error code (form-rules.md section 7). Key = CODE or CODE.variant; the variant selection rule is in form-rules.md. Text follows docs/ux/ux-spec.md section 8.3. {name} marks a placeholder; the allowed placeholders are listed in 'placeholders'.

messages.INVALID_TYPE.URL: Enter a valid web address starting with http:// or https://.
messages.INVALID_TYPE.DATETIME: Enter a valid date and time.
messages.OUT_OF_RANGE.min: Enter a value of {min} or more.
messages.OUT_OF_RANGE.max: Enter a value of {max} or less.
messages.OUT_OF_RANGE.default: Enter a value within the allowed range.
messages.OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED: Choose one of the available options.
messages.UNKNOWN_FIELD: This field is not part of the form.
messages.DUPLICATE_FIELD_KEY: Two fields share the key {field}. Give each field its own key.
messages.INVALID_FIELD_KEY: Use a key that starts with a lowercase letter and has only lowercase letters, digits and underscores (up to 64 characters).
messages.UNKNOWN_CONTROL: {field} uses a control type that isn't supported.
messages.DUPLICATE_OPTION_KEY: Two options of {field} share a key. Give each option its own key.
messages.INVALID_OPTION_KEY: Use an option key that starts with a letter or digit and has only letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (up to 64 characters).
messages.INVALID_VALIDATION: The limits on {field} aren't valid. Check the minimum, maximum, length and error message.
messages.INVALID_PATTERN: The format pattern on {field} can't be used. Use only the supported pattern syntax.
messages.SCHEMA_VIOLATION: A rule on {field} isn't valid. Check each condition.
messages.RULE_TOO_DEEP: A rule on {field} has too many nested conditions. Use at most 3 levels.
messages.UNKNOWN_FIELD_REFERENCE: A rule on {field} refers to a field that doesn't exist.
messages.INVALID_REFERENCE_TARGET: A rule on {field} refers to a heading or help text. Rules can only refer to fields that hold a value.
messages.CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY: These fields depend on each other: {cycle}. Remove one rule.
messages.OPERATOR_TYPE_MISMATCH: A condition on {field} can't be used with that type of field.
messages.LITERAL_TYPE_MISMATCH: A value in a rule on {field} doesn't fit the type of the field it checks.
messages.UNKNOWN_OPTION_REFERENCE: A rule on {field} refers to an option that doesn't exist.
messages.INVALID_SECTION: {field} must belong to a section heading of this form.
